200.description: Returns a page of messages from the folder, newest first.

total.description: Total number of messages matching the query (exact for IMAP, approximate for Gmail API, can be omitted for MS Graph API and Outlook search results)

pages.description: Total number of pages available (exact for IMAP, approximate for Gmail API, can be omitted for MS Graph API and Outlook search results)

nextPageCursor.description: Cursor for fetching the next page (null when no more pages)

prevPageCursor.description: Cursor for fetching the previous page

uid.description: IMAP UID (unique identifier within the mailbox). IMAP accounts only

emailId.description: Globally unique email identifier (when supported by the email server)

threadId.description: Thread identifier for email conversations (when supported by the email server)

path.description: Mailbox folder path that contains this message. Returned when listing a virtual folder like "\\All" or when extended info is requested

date.description: Date when the message was received by the mail server

draft.description: Whether this message is a draft

answered.description: Whether this message has been answered (IMAP accounts only)

name.description: Display name for the email address

address.description: Email address (can be empty for name-only entries)

items.description: Email address with optional display name

name.description: Display name for the email address

address.description: Email address (can be empty for name-only entries)

items.title: RcptAddressEntry

items.description: Email address with optional display name

name.description: Display name for the email address

address.description: Email address (can be empty for name-only entries)

items.title: RcptAddressEntry

items.description: Email address with optional display name

name.description: Display name for the email address

address.description: Email address (can be empty for name-only entries)

items.title: RcptAddressEntry

inReplyTo.description: Message-ID of the message this is replying to

flags.description: IMAP flags set on this message
flags.title: FlagList

labels.description: Gmail labels applied to this message
labels.title: LabelList

encodedSize.description: Size of the attachment as stored in the email (base64 encoded). The actual decoded file size is approximately 75% of this value.

embedded.description: Whether the attachment is embedded in the HTML content

inline.description: Whether the attachment should be displayed inline rather than as a download

encodedInMessage.description: Whether the attachment is part of an enclosed message/rfc822 attachment rather than the message itself

contentId.description: Content-ID header value used for embedding images in HTML

method.description: Calendar method (REQUEST, REPLY, CANCEL, etc.) for iCalendar attachments

id.description: Identifier for fetching the full message text

plain.description: Size of the plain text part in bytes

html.description: Size of the HTML part in bytes

preview.description: Short preview of the message content
preview.example: Hello, here is the report you asked for

category.description: Gmail inbox tab/category of the message (Gmail API accounts only)

enumDescriptions.social: The Social tab (notifications from social networks)
enumDescriptions.forums: The Forums tab (mailing lists and discussion groups)

category.title: MessageCategory

messageSpecialUse.description: Special folder type where this message is stored

enumDescriptions.\\All: Contains every message in the account (Gmail "All Mail")
enumDescriptions.\\Flagged: Messages the user flagged or starred

messageSpecialUse.title: MessageSpecialUse

isAutoReply.description: Whether this message appears to be an automatic reply (out of office, vacation responder, etc.)

400.description: Invalid input - the path parameters, query arguments, or request payload did not pass validation. Also returned when the email server refused the request, in which case the response carries a code and the server response instead of a field list

fields.description: List of input fields that failed validation

message.example: "pageSize" must be less than or equal to 1000

key.description: Name of the input field that failed validation

path.description: Full path of the input field that failed validation. Same as key for a top-level field, dotted for a nested one

fields.title: ValidationErrorFields

details.description: Additional error details, if available. The email server response for a refused mailbox operation

info.description: Additional error details, if available. The email server response for a refused message operation

401.description: Authentication failed - the access token is missing, invalid, or was not accepted

403.description: Access denied - the access token does not grant permission for this operation (token scope, account, or IP address restriction)

requestedScope.description: The scope the operation needed, when the token does not carry it

requiredPermission.description: The permission grant the operation needed, when the token permissions do not include it

remoteAddress.description: The client IP address, when the token is restricted to other addresses

404.description: Not found - the requested entity (account, message, mailbox, etc.) does not exist

429.description: Rate limit exceeded - too many requests were made with this access token

ttl.description: Seconds until the rate limit window resets

500.description: Internal server error - an unexpected error occurred while processing the request

503.description: Service unavailable - the worker processing this account is not available, try again later

message.example: No active handler for requested account. Try again later.
